structured.answer: I understood what a fixed deposit is: money locked for a set time at a fixed or changing interest rate, 15% tax on the interest, and a fine from the bank if I break it early. But the page didn't tell me what my bank actually pays or what breaking would cost me, and it scared me with "no deposit insurance" and an example where I get back less than I put in, so I'll ask my son and the bank before doing anything.

stuck.where: Calculator box, screen 1: "נשאר לכם 68,270 ₪" versus "ההפקדות שלכם 70,000 ₪"
stuck.why: It looks as if the deposit gives back less than I put in. I didn't understand that "בכסף של היום" meant something else, and it frightened me.

stuck.where: "סיכונים ומה לא מוגן" and "שווה לדעת": "אין ביטוח פיקדונות"
stuck.why: It contradicts what I believed, that a deposit is safe. I didn't know whether to believe it or how worried to be.
I wanted to know what I lose by breaking a deposit, and it says the site doesn't calculate it and the fine is set by the bank.
It only says "לפי התעריף של הגורם המציע", with no number.

used: Title and opening line "כסף שמפקידים בבנק לתקופה מוסכמת"
"מה זה" paragraphs: fixed/variable interest, automatic renewal, linked/unlinked
"שווה לדעת": 15% tax, breaking a deposit, no deposit insurance
Tax cards and red box about breaking a deposit
skimmed: "למה משתמשים בזה" paragraph about money market funds
Low-income tax exemption paragraph with 69,840 and 10,920
skipped: Sliders and input boxes in the calculator
unsure_meaning: בכסף של היום / בשקלים של העתיד
TXI-03, BANK-06, BANK-23, TXI OQ14, TXI-17, TXI-04
קרן כספית, מק"מ, מוצרי שוק הכסף
not_found: Actual current deposit rates at my bank or any bank
How much the fine for breaking a deposit actually is
Whether something equally safe pays more than a deposit
A plain sentence explaining why the example ends with less than was deposited

findings.what: The example shows 68,270 ₪ left against 70,000 ₪ deposited, with no plain sentence saying why. It looks like the deposit loses money.
"אין ביטוח פיקדונות" is alarming, and there is nothing next to it saying how likely a bank collapse is or what to do about it
Breaking a deposit early, the thing I most wanted to understand, isn't calculated, only "הקנס הוא תנאי של הבנק"
Costs say only "לפי התעריף של הגורם המציע", with no amount
Dark background with light grey small text is hard to read even enlarged
findings.where: Notes under the calculator inputs, small lines under tax cards, side menu

findings.what: Codes in English letters (TXI-03, BANK-06) mean nothing to me
Busy calculator with sliders, pencils, tags and many numbers on the first screen
Unknown personal site; I wouldn't act on it alone
